metadata.title: तिपरा समझौते पर आर-पार के मूड में प्रद्योत माणिक्य | Tiprasa Accord Can’t Wait: Pradyot Manikya
metadata.description:
At a massive gathering of Indigenous people from Tripura at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi today, Tipra Motha chief Pradyot Kishor Manikya sent out a strong message to the central government. Reiterating the urgency of implementing the Tiprasa Accord, he declared that he will not wait indefinitely for promises to be fulfilled. Manikya directly urged Union Home Minister Amit Shah to intervene and overrule the BJP’s state leadership in Tripura, accusing them of delaying justice for the tribal community. The rally witnessed a spirited show of unity and determination by the Indigenous people of Tripura, demanding constitutional safeguards and a swift resolution to their long-pending issues.
#tripura #bubagra
